notes:
The in-house list now feeds the tool straight from protel — press “Read the in-house list” on the Tax Check screen and the rooms, the whole guest names and the arrival and departure dates go in without a Rate Check file. Names come through uncut, which the .oxps never did. It only ever reads: nothing is written to protel and nothing is sent to it beyond the getters the read needs.

It also reads the window you are actually looking at. Before, with a report open but not maximised, it could read the list sitting behind it — so it now takes the active protel window and refuses outright when that window's title does not say in-house, or carries no date. The refusal shows you the title it saw.
